name: ModelVariant380_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant380_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x44-byte command row at data + 0x38 indexed by the request, gets one slot part per configured beam and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame (beams once the phase is positive, sheets, streamers from phase 4) and returns 4 in phases 3-6, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image that builds the entry; the PAL images build it through french_model_variant/variant397_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x (the PAL raw slot-1 images 5986/71418 build only the sheets helper); HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
